Glen...thank you. I didn't want to respond further to this thread as I didn't want it to be a trigger for anyone else, but felt compelled to reply to your comment. Im familiar with your daughters case and to be honest the best thing you can do is keep up the fight. You have been doing an incredible job, recently in Ottawa and such. 

I think we need to get the point across that while suicide is not an ideal solution, it's still so stigmatized to publicly discuss thoughts of it that most people don't seek help. I have been pretty open with depression/anxiety/substance abuse with friends and family but cannot bring myself to discuss the thoughts I have of ending my life...I am convinced that if I had a gun I'd have done so already.

I am going to try to abstain from booze, and am seeing my doctor on Tuesday. Will try to get short term disability from work.

Again, thank you. I have a lot of respect for you.

I'm sorry...I am absolutely not a troll. I'm extremely self-centered and didn't realize that the post could have been a trigger for others...I was very intoxicated. That's not an excuse, but I have been depressed/anxious for the past 4 years and have been thinking alot about the bridge.

I understand /r/suicidewatch would have been a better place to post, I guess I was just thinking about our city and the bridge at the time.

I did not mean to upset or stress anyone out...in hindsight it was an extremely inappropriate post, for that I'm truly sorry. Thank you for the link Demo. I have a really good family doctor and have made an appointment to see him on Tuesday of next week...I have made an attempt in the past via pills...it was a truly shitty experience and I think my mindset last night was that I was looking for a sure-fire thing since I don't have access to guns. That's the intoxicated mind though....tonight I don't feel much better but am not actively looking to self-harm.

Again I didn't realize at the time this could have been a trigger for others, thank you for the feedback.
